responseText:
I was hired to lead those two down into the dark. Dunno what they were after, never asked, so long as their coin clinked true. But listen, no pouch's fat enough to make me die stupid. Those tunnels? Cursed, twisted, and worse. 

They marched on without me. If they're still breathin?, I'd wager they'll pay handsomely for someone with steel to haul 'em out. And if they're not... well, gold don't care who's carryin' it.
